# triangulation.library: RingSlot

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The buffer slot at ring position `i` of the pool range starting at `start`:
> the pool order when `forward`, the reverse when not. Reversing is how a ring
> stored the wrong way round is rewound. Precondition: 0 \<= i \< count.

## Signature

```plato
RingSlot(start: Integer, count: Integer, forward: Boolean, i: Integer): Integer
```
